records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Jules,

Your workspace for Blue Partners is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Best,

records.text: New signup alert -- *Blue Partners* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero activity: no project, no invite, no milestone, no tickets, and no reply to either outreach ([email:2d7207b3], [email:41a18c57]). Silent, fully unengaged accounts rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days; Pro plan gives some intent, so not near-zero.

draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Jules,

Following up on my last note "" no pressure if the first week has been busy. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in place is usually what makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd rather do it solo.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to work through setting up that first project with you live and answer anything along the way.

Best,
Nadia
